strings.name: Arvind Krishna
strings.summary: Krishna entered IBM through electrical engineering and computing research, later managing research and enterprise software before becoming CEO in 2020. He helped drive the Red Hat acquisition and led a hybrid-cloud and AI strategy, including the Kyndryl separation and HashiCorp acquisition. These were collective company efforts; his career connects technical research with large-enterprise transformation.
